data_dictionary.none_state: NONE means the strategic base is destroyed or demolished and has not been rebuilt by either faction; it is effectively no-man's-land.
data_dictionary.rate_trends: Adjacent equal-window comparison. Array order is [recent_per_hour, previous_per_hour, change_per_hour, direction].
data_dictionary.recent_events: A direct ownership flip can produce a loss row plus a capture row for the same state transition.
data_dictionary.selected_metrics: Evidence citation keys whose values and observation times are frozen at prediction time.
data_dictionary.total_enlistments: Cumulative unique players who have deployed to this region during the war. A player can count in multiple regions. This is not current population or a faction split; its change is only a new-to-that-region activity proxy.

previous_model_summary.headline: Strategic Fronts Stir Across Central Sectors
previous_model_summary.war_summary: Since the last edition, the ledger shows fresh movement on several contested fronts. Stlican Shelf has risen from 28 to 32 base events in 24 hours, including four in the latest two-hour window; its nine strategic bases remain split five Warden to four Colonial. Stonecradle, still divided four to five, has likewise recorded five recent events and 28 across the day. Weathered Expanse remains a furious nine-base contest, with four events in two hours and 29 in 24, while casualties and enlistments are accelerating. Godcrofts retains the day’s heaviest recorded turnover at 72 events, but its latest activity was earlier and all nine bases remain Colonial-held. Fisherman’s Row is quieter at the moment, though its 39 daily events—chiefly around Arcadia and Eidolo—mark it as an unsettled sector. Deadlands has newly entered the dispatch with three events, all at Callahan’s Gate, including a recent Warden capture sequence; its casualty and enlistment rates are accelerating sharply. Other fronts show heavy fighting without recorded base turnover in the latest intervals.
